'''Varmik'''<ref name="SWCT">{{SWCT|set=Galactic Underworld|cardname=Varmik}}</ref> was near-feral [[subhumanoid]] [[Hassk]] thug. Together with their [[Hassk triplets|two siblings]], frequented [[Takodana Castle]] and often itched for trouble. Varmik carried a battered [[VT-33d blaster pistol]].<ref name="TFAVD" /> In [[34 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VII}} to [[34 BBY]].</ref> the the triplets were present at Takodana Castle when the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] entered with the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], the former [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn]] and the [[Astromech droid]] [[BB-8]]. Not long after the four newcomers arrived, many of the patrons in the castle rushed outside to witness the [[First Order]] [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destroying]] the [[Hosnian system]] with their [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]]. Kanata's castle was then [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] and destroyed by the forces of the First Order.<ref name="VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Strono_no_mask.png|thumb|right|250px|Varmik was portrayed by [[Paul Warren]] in ''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens''.]]
Varmik first appeared in the [[2015]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens]]''<ref name="VII" /> and was portrayed by the actor [[Paul Warren]].<ref name="Twitter" /> Varmik's name was first confirmed by an official source on the packaging of a POP vinyl toy of the character released around the release of the film.<ref name="amazon">{{Amazon|url=Funko-POP-Star-Wars-Episode/dp/B019RP7E8O|text=Funko POP Star Wars: Episode 7 - Varmik Action Figure}}</ref> Warren used "he/him" pronouns for the character.<ref name="Twitter" />
